extracted.name: Peanut butter protein bars
extracted.description: No bake homemade snack bars. Note: Above is chocolate chip, dried strawberry, flax seed. Some other combinations: dried blueberry, sunflower seeds, almonds. Raisin, sunflower seeds and pumpkin seeds. Cocoa and dried raspberries.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup all natural unsalted peanut butter
1/3 cup honey (still too sweet, though reduced from 1/2 c)
1/4 c Freeze Dried strawberries or raspberries
instruction_lines: Put peanut butter and honey in a food processor bowl. Pulse to combine with the mixing blade.
Add oats and protein powder. Pulse until combined
Fold in add ins as desired.
Turn out into a parchment lined 8 x 8" pan. Press to form a large square.
Cover and freeze for 30 min-1 hr. Defrost for 10 mins and cut into bars.
Wrap bars in parchment paper. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.
